scenario.title: Punish the Traitors!
intro.text:
PUNISH THE TRAITORS! - 10 OCT 1943

East of Kalabaka, Thessaly

Welcome to Greece, Commander! Experienced leaders like you we are needed urgently. The 13th ELAS Division is now under your command and your first task is a punishment operation against the traitorous EDES Bandits be making common cause with the Germans! Currently, the EDES control parts of the road Ioannina-Metsovo-Kalabaka. You will attack the EDES around Kalabaka and bring the area back under our control!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE If you do not like the composition of your new Core, you can sell units and acquire new ones with same experience. However, the increased 35% chance for a leader get lost. New units start with a chance of 10%!

The unit occupying the town Spathades, gets the chance of a Leader!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-21-0-briliant.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.reaction-21-0-briliant.text: The detachment cleared the exits before the cordon closed. It will reach Greece with trained cadres and a story every side will retell differently.
line.reaction-21-1-victory-tactical.text: Enough of the detachment escaped to remain a formation. The men left behind will face courts, camps, or a second attempt without us.
line.callback-0.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.callback-0.text: The rifles from Egypt made us a detachment before ELAS had decided whether to trust us. The Greek guards we passed tell the story differently. Both versions have followed you into these mountains.
line.callback-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-1.text: No funeral closed the quiet channel I kept to Cairo. The government still calls us deserters, but families and messages have crossed that channel. Your restraint bought more than a clean departure.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.earned-decision.text: The mounted party from Egypt has reached these passes with the same officers and nearly the same horses. ELAS can use it as a troop, or use every rider as a courier by tomorrow.
line.earned-decision.choice.keep-elas-ca: Keep the mounted group as an ELAS reconnaissance detachment.
Add an experienced seven-strength ELAS cavalry detachment.
line.earned-decision.choice.distribute-e: Distribute the riders, fuel, and veterans through the core.
Give infantry 10 experience and fully refuel the core.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.earned-a-response.text: Keep them together. They crossed enough frontiers to deserve one commander who knows all their names.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.earned-b-response.text: Split the troop. The valleys need couriers, guides, and men who have seen an army move farther than the next village.
line.scene-0.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.scene-0.text: EDES has put British rifles in the passes and a Greek flag over the depot. They expect those two facts to settle who commands here.
line.scene-1.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.scene-1.text: Their headquarters and stores are legitimate targets. Their village companies are another matter. Turn every EDES man into a hunted enemy and the occupation receives a civil war for free.
line.scene-2.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.scene-2.text: Our new commander has come from Cairo. Let us hear whether Cairo taught caution or merely dressed it better.
line.scene-3.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.scene-3.text: Cairo taught us what happens when Greeks stack rifles under somebody else's guard. It did not teach us to leave an armed rival on our road.
line.decision.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.decision.text: Do we disarm EDES throughout the area, or strike its command posts and publish terms for rank-and-file units that stand aside?
line.decision.choice.disarm-edes.text: Disarm every EDES formation in the area.
line.decision.choice.disarm-edes.hint: Give infantry and artillery 15 experience and fully rearm the core.
line.decision.choice.offer-rank-and-file: Strike the headquarters and stores, but offer neutrality and amnesty to ordinary fighters.
Spend 75 prestige, restore the core to at least nine strength, and fully refuel and rearm it.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.choice-a-0.text: Complete disarmament will not remain a tidy operation. Name holding areas now, and forbid the word 'traitor' in arrest lists unless someone can attach an act to it.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.choice-a-1.text: Fine. Rifles collected, officers separated, village companies sent home without weapons. Nobody changes his unit's name and keeps the depot.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Aris Velouchiotis
line.choice-b-0.text: Amnesty leaves men, couriers, and grudges in place. When they return with British ammunition, I will remind you whose signature they carried away.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Stefanos Sarafis
line.choice-b-1.text: You may. The terms name units, hours, and collection points. Headquarters that refuse them are attacked; men who accept them leave unarmed.
